data: Un vaisseau spatial lancé dans l’univers. Sept membres d’équipage se réveillent malencontreusement de cryogénisation. Sans doute trop longue, celle-ci les a rendu amnésiques : ils ne savent ni où ils sont, ni d’où ils viennent, ni où ils vont. L'un d'entre eux, le plus dépressif, le vivra comme un vrai chemin de croix. (A space-ship is lost in space, conveying a small team of scientists who no longer know, probably due to too long a cryogenisation period, where they are, where they're going, or where they've come from. One of them, the most depressed, will live this moment as a huge hardship.)

A space-ship is lost in space, conveying a small team of scientists who no longer know, probably due to too long a cryogenisation period, where they are, where they're going, or where they've come from. One of them, the most depressed, will live this moment as a huge hardship.
